name: agent-build-orchestrator
description: Spec-to-shipped multi-agent build orchestration for any app and any AI coding tools: clarity sprint, guided questionnaire, skills plan, lanes, provider failover, never-twice memory, reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Run a multi-agent build from spec to shipped code
interface.longDescription: Makes the spec buildable (P1/P2/P3, acceptance criteria), asks how you want to run the build, plans skills per task type, sets up the workspace, runs parallel lanes with one merge gate, fails over between providers on usage limits, and reports progress.
defaultPrompt: Set up the build orchestration for my app - the spec is in docs/
